now.wind_regime_note: Offshore, cold and gusty. Short fetch at the coast so the water often runs clear, but the surface is hard work and gusts build fast.

species.note: Resident on rocky edges year round. The bread-and-butter fish here; holds tight to structure and comes back to the same rock.

species.note: Roaming predator that works drop-off edges rather than sitting on structure. Needs clear water and long, still waits. Rare in the shallow north Adriatic shelf — expect this one to score low here most days, and treat a high score as worth the drive.
Lives in holes, caves and under overhangs — the highest relief affinity in this list. Protected or restricted in parts of the Adriatic; CHECK THE CURRENT RULES before targeting it.
Works soft bottom and seagrass, not rock — so it scores where the rest of the model scores low. Extremely wary in clear water; coloured water is your friend.

species.note: The exception to everything else in this file. Hunts stirred, coloured water and river outflow — the conditions that make the day look bad. Best on the days you would otherwise stay home.

species.note: Rubble and rock edges, in holes. Barely cares about visibility and does not spook, so it salvages otherwise poor days. Best in the cooler months.
Seagrass and sand, strongly seasonal — the spring inshore spawning run is the window. Scores where rock-loving species do not.
